summary: Forces an immediate layout rebuild, fixing the Content Size Fitter one-frame flicker.
overview: Unity defers layout rebuilds to end of frame, so a runtime content change visibly shows the OLD size for one frame before snapping. This walks the hierarchy children-first and rebuilds immediately, which removes the flicker.
useCases: Text or children added at runtime inside a Content Size Fitter.
Measuring a layout in the same frame you populated it.
Any visible one-frame pop after a content change.

gotchas.title: Children first, and that order matters
gotchas.body: Rebuilding a parent before its children measures stale child sizes, which is exactly the bug it exists to avoid.

gotchas.title: Immediate means expensive
gotchas.body: Use it where the flicker is visible, not as a habit. The deferred rebuild exists for a reason.
